sent_bad: **Trigger:** Performed immediately when a player exhibits or reports a sign/symptom of concussion, spinal cord neuropraxia, or a concern is raised by gameday medical personnel.

**Trigger:** The more complete, follow-up evaluation — required when the sideline assessment is positive/inconclusive/suspicious, when "No-Go" criteria are present, or when symptoms worsen or progress.

**In short:** the sideline survey is the immediate, on-the-spot screening (No-Go review, history, Maddocks' questions, video review, focused neuro exam) done in the sideline tent with NFL-assigned technology, which can clear a player to return to play; the locker room exam is the comprehensive, standardized (SCAT 5-based) assessment done in the locker room when the sideline findings are positive,
